AD-100 — Starting selection brief
Manufacturer: Boya Gongdao

A remotely operated platform described in the manufacturer brochure for underwater sump dredging, with suction, conveyance and treatment selected together.

Vehicle weight: 100 kg
Dimensions: 815 × 620 × 690 mm
Thruster arrangement: 6 (2 horizontal + 4 vertical)
Cameras: Front and rear
Depth rating: Confirm for the supplied system
Brochure separation capacity: 5 m³/h; treatment unit only

Configuration note: The 5 m³/h figure relates to the supporting mud-water separation equipment. It is not a verified net sediment-removal rate. Confirm performance with representative sediment and the full pump-and-pipe system.

Confirm current specifications and delivered scope with the manufacturer before purchase.
